cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
TUMBLE FEATURE
 The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning
 symbols disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions
 are replaced with new symbols coming from above.
 Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.

scatters.name: SCATTER
scatters.behavior:
FREE SPINS
 Hit 4, 5 or 6 SCATTER symbols to trigger the FREE SPINS feature and win 10, 12 or 14 free spins respectively.
 During the FREE SPINS round, the multipliers on the multiplier reel are not reset between free spins and
 continue to grow by x1 after every tumble until the end of the round. If BOMB symbols hit during the round,
 their multiplier is added to the current progress.
 Hit 3 or more SCATTER symbols during the round to retrigger the feature and win 5 additional free spins.
 Special reels are in play during the feature.

features.name: Tumble Feature
features.effects:
The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning
 symbols disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions
 are replaced with new symbols coming from above.
 Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.

 MULTIPLIER REEL
 An extra reel showing multipliers is present in the game. For every spin, the multiplier starts from x1 and after
 every tumble, it increases by x1. All wins in the game are multiplied by the middle multiplier from this reel. After
 every spin and all tumbles resulted from it, the multipliers on this reel are reset.
 This is the BOMB symbol. It can hit anywhere on the screen.
 Whenever it hits, it carries a random multiplier value that is
 added to the current value on the multiplier reel.
 Possible mutlipliers on the BOMB symbols are: x3, x4, x5, x6, x8, x10, x12, x15, x20, x25, x50, x100 or x500.

features.name: Buy Free Spins
features.effects:
The FREE SPINS ROUND can be instantly triggered from the base game by buying it for 100x current total bet.
 When buying the free spins round 4, 5 or 6 SCATTERS are guaranteed to hit randomly on the triggering spin.
